description: Equibles is a stock-market research platform covering US and international listings, with structured data from regulatory filings, earnings calls, ownership, short data, prices, macro series, and related datasets. It also offers ALVIS, an AI analyst that reads across those datasets and cites figures back to their primary sources.
summary: Equibles exposes two developer integration surfaces on its own domains: a REST API at `https://api.equibles.com/v1` authenticated by `eq_` API keys, and an MCP server at `https://mcp.equibles.com/mcp` that supports either the same API key or OAuth with dynamic client registration.
